entries.columnsContract: `intent_id PK, perception_acquisition_id FK, actor_id, idempotency_key, request_digest, scope_digest, created_at_ms`
entries.constraintsContract: 用户主动继续同一Acquisition的immutable Intent；`UNIQUE(actor_id,idempotency_key)`；`INDEX(perception_acquisition_id,intent_id)`；只对active且当前Source/config相同的Douban采集签发；重放先于current-state校验；存在Intent后该Acquisition按normal准入，Scope内原始executionOrigin不变

entries.columnsContract: `perception_source_id FK, revision, perception_acquisition_id FK, cursor_in, cursor_out, observation_page_digest, has_more, committed_at_ms`
entries.constraintsContract: `PK(perception_source_id,revision)`；revision从1递增且不重置；Source current pointer显式复合FK引用；仅Source从未同步时expected revision为0，配置/scope不兼容的后续Acquisition可令`cursor_in=null`但仍CAS当前非零revision；不覆盖历史

entries.columnsContract: `acquisition_commit_receipt_id PK, perception_acquisition_id FK, perception_source_id FK, page_ordinal, expected_cursor_revision, committed_cursor_revision, observation_page_digest, commit_marker, result_schema_ref, result_json, result_digest, committed_at_ms`
entries.constraintsContract: `UNIQUE(perception_acquisition_id,page_ordinal)`、`UNIQUE(commit_marker)`；Result JSON上限`64 KiB`且保存不含自digest字段的原始`perceptionIds/insertedCount/duplicateCount` typed result，`result_digest=SHA-256(JCS(result_json))`并与Event Result相同；与Record、Relation、cursor head、marker、Event Result和Outbox同事务

entries.columnsContract: `perception_id PK, perception_source_id FK, perception_acquisition_id FK, acquisition_commit_receipt_id FK, record_kind(observation|correction|retraction), source_kind, source_record_key, source_record_revision, source_record_digest, normalization_rule_ref, rating, watched_state, observed_title, provenance_ref, provenance_digest, record_digest, observed_at_ms, committed_at_ms`
entries.constraintsContract: immutable；`record_digest`覆盖Record标量与按键排序的Identity Anchor set；`UNIQUE(perception_source_id,source_record_key,source_record_revision,source_record_digest)`；Canonical rating非空时`CHECK integer 1..5`且`0`禁止，`watched_state`只允许`NULL|0|1`；CommitParticipant要求correction/retraction在同页各有匹配的outgoing `supersedes/retracts` relation；`INDEX(source_kind,source_record_key,committed_at_ms)`
`PK(perception_id,anchor_kind,anchor_value)`；结构化Anchor不可退化为字符串数组；`INDEX(anchor_kind,anchor_value)`

entries.columnsContract: `relation_id PK, relation_kind(duplicate_of|supersedes|retracts), source_perception_id FK, target_perception_id FK, rule_revision, evidence_digest, committed_at_ms`
entries.constraintsContract: immutable；source不得等于target；`UNIQUE(relation_kind,source_perception_id,target_perception_id)`；`duplicate_of`使用规范化pair，`supersedes|retracts`保持方向性

entries.columnsContract: `resolution_id PK, query_contract, query_schema_ref, query_input_digest, fact_kind, revision, record_set_digest, rule_revision, rule_digest, result_kind, winning_perception_id NULL, reason_code NULL, result_schema_ref, result_json, result_digest, resolved_at_ms`
entries.constraintsContract: `UNIQUE(query_contract,query_input_digest,revision,resolution_id)`供head精确复合FK；`winning_perception_id`显式FK；found必须有winner且reason为NULL，not_found必须无winner并具有`no_matching_record|requested_fact_absent|strongest_value_conflict`之一；`result_json`保存完整typed `PerceptionResolutionRevision`且≤`16 KiB`，digest使用统一JCS basis；current pointer/index按query digest

`PK(query_contract,query_input_digest)`；四列显式复合FK引用同一`perception_resolution_revisions(query_contract,query_input_digest,revision,resolution_id)`；head CAS与新revision/typed result在同一Resolution Commit事务；Resolution Facade只读head，不在热路径计算`MAX(revision)`

entries.columnsContract: `person_id PK, library_kind(normal|jav|us_adult), status(active|merged), current_revision, current_preference_revision NULL, current_reference_revision NULL, current_reference_projection_revision, current_reference_projection_digest, created_at_ms, terminal_at_ms`
entries.constraintsContract: `current_revision`显式复合FK引用`people_person_revisions`；nullable Preference/Reference pointer分别显式复合FK引用对应revision表；`current_reference_revision IS NULL`表示尚无Reference revision，Commit逻辑expected `0`映射为“期望不存在”而不是存储revision 0；两个Projection checkpoint字段均`NOT NULL`，`CHECK(current_reference_projection_revision>=1)`且digest为64位lowercase hex；Person成立时以revision `1`和无Reference语义payload的digest初始化；与child表的循环FK均`DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED`；`INDEX(library_kind,status,person_id)`

entries.columnsContract: `operation_id PK, person_id, actor_id, idempotency_key, request_digest, payload_schema_ref, payload_json, payload_digest, state(preparing|completed|failed), result_schema_ref NULL, result_json NULL, result_digest NULL, failure_code NULL, created_at_ms, updated_at_ms`
entries.constraintsContract: `UNIQUE(actor_id,idempotency_key)`；`INDEX(state,operation_id)`；payload schema固定`people.image-operation-request@1`，closed字段`schema,operationKind(registration|reference_add),expectedPersonRevision,expectedReferenceRevision,operationId,personId,actorId,canonicalName,aliases,selectedImage,faceModelRef`，≤`16 KiB`并完整JCS digest；registration的person_id为未发布身份的预分配ID；reference_add指向已发布Person并冻结两项expected revision，不能FK或由operation自身当作Person事实；state仅从preparing执行terminal CAS；completed schema固定`people.image-operation-result@1`，closed结果`personId,personRevision,referenceRevision`，≤`16 KiB`；failed保存明确错误码且无result；只有内部工作流及用户本次operation只读查询可见，不构成确认队列

entries.columnsContract: `cycle_id PK, state(active|complete), revision INTEGER, progress_schema_ref, progress_json, progress_digest, created_at_ms, updated_at_ms`
entries.constraintsContract: `INDEX(state,cycle_id)`；进度schema固定`people.us-adult-recommendation-progress@1`，closed字段`schema,policy,stage,sourceCursor,sourceExhausted,pendingSourceId,groupCursor,bestGroup,rankSourceCursor,rankGroupCursor,leaders,windowKey,assignedSinceRank,rankPassId`，最多`16 KiB`并按JCS digest校验；revision CAS；policy固定版本、64组分页及最多五位，不持有Person身份或跨域写权限；stage为source_scan/group_scan/refresh_sources/rank_groups；leaders最多五个有界排名摘要

entries.columnsContract: `cycle_id PK FK, source_id PK, libra_run_id, group_id NULL, observation_schema_ref, observation_json, observation_digest, created_at_ms`
entries.constraintsContract: `UNIQUE(cycle_id,libra_run_id)`；`INDEX(cycle_id,group_id,source_id)`；`FOREIGN KEY(cycle_id) REFERENCES people_us_recommendation_cycles(cycle_id)`；Observation schema固定`people.us-adult-recommendation-observation@1`，closed字段`schema,source,image,observationDigest`，其中source严格为UsAdultRecommendationSource，image严格为版本化受控图片Evidence；最多`128 KiB`并校验JCS digest；group_id只允许首次分配，不产生影片Actor关系；libra_run_id只是公开来源引用，不创建跨Owner FK

entries.columnsContract: `cycle_id PK FK, group_id PK, representative_source_id, coverage_count INTEGER, quality_score REAL, rank_pass_id NULL, rank_coverage_count INTEGER, rank_representative_source_id NULL, rank_quality_score REAL NULL, revision INTEGER`
entries.constraintsContract: `INDEX(cycle_id,group_id)`；`FOREIGN KEY(cycle_id) REFERENCES people_us_recommendation_cycles(cycle_id)`；来源代表必须由People Owner重验属于同cycle的Observation；coverage为cycle内已归组来源数，rank计数只属于指定版本排名pass重验后的有效来源；清晰度相同时按sourceId稳定选图；revision CAS，禁止把该内部分组当作Person合并
